reason: Both meet the hard requirements (named phases with percentages/entry criteria, five correctly formatted RISK lines, numeric halt thresholds, and the phase-count footer), but Response B more directly satisfies the decommissioning constraint by giving decommissioning its own explicit, later phase (with its own entry criteria) rather than just declaring it 'out of scope,' and it pairs this with a more diverse risk set (tax engine mismatches, payment tokenization, rollback SLA) and a clearer halt/resume procedure.
